reviews.title: Formal Complaint Regarding MAPS.ME’s Misrepresentation of Georgia’s Territorial Integrity
reviews.text:
MAPS.ME is one of the most misleading and irresponsible mapping applications I have ever seen. It is deeply shameful that your application presents Abkhazia and the Tskhinvali/South Ossetia regions as separate from Georgia, despite Georgia’s internationally recognized territorial integrity.

The overwhelming majority of the international community recognizes these territories as part of Georgia. A mapping application should reflect internationally recognized borders and provide accurate, responsible information — not create or reinforce politically misleading representations.

It is extremely disappointing and unacceptable that an application used by millions of people can present such a sensitive territorial issue in this way. Maps are not just lines on a screen; they influence how people understand countries, borders, and reality.

I strongly urge MAPS.ME to review this representation and correct it in accordance with internationally recognized borders. Otherwise, I will consider submitting a formal complaint regarding the misleading information presented by your application.

This is not only a technical mistake — it is a matter of accuracy, responsibility, and respect for international law.
